Metadata.title: Holo | Simple File & Text Sharing
Metadata.description: Share files and text instantly between devices. No accounts, no storage - just a room.

LegalMetadata.termsDescription: Holo provides ephemeral file and text sharing with no storage. Open-source, no accounts required. Use at your own responsibility.
LegalMetadata.privacyDescription: How Holo handles shared content, connections, cookies, analytics and error reports.

Brand.footer: no storage · no accounts · just a room

HomePage.subtitle:
Share any file or text instantly.
Just create a room and share the 6‑character code.
